About ResumeAI Version %1$s Build a professional resume in minutes, on your device. What is ResumeAI? ResumeAI is a fully offline, privacy-first Android app that helps you create polished, professional resumes from scratch. Fill in your details, pick a template, customise the accent colour, and export a ready-to-share PDF — no account, no sign-up, and no data ever leaves your phone. Core Features Personal Details Name, designation, email, phone, and address. Objective Write or AI-generate a compelling career objective. Education Add multiple education entries with dates and grades. Work Experience Log jobs with AI-improved bullet-point descriptions. Skills Add skills manually or let AI suggest 10 relevant ones. Projects Showcase projects with links and AI-generated summaries. Achievements Highlight awards and accomplishments, AI-assisted. Languages & More Languages, interests, hobbies, and a declaration section. Profile Photo Attach a profile photo and signature directly from your camera or gallery. Templates & Design 13 Templates Classic, Modern, Minimal, Bold, Elegant, Creative, Two-Column, Academic, Developer, Designer, Portfolio, Teacher, Code Dark. Accent Colour Pick any colour — it applies to your header, section titles, and dividers instantly. PDF Export Export your resume as a high-quality PDF, ready to send to employers. AI-Powered Features The app integrates an AI assistant to help you write and refine resume content. Tap the ✨ sparkle icon inside any supported section to generate or improve text instantly. Objective Generator Writes a professional career objective tailored to your designation. Job Description AI Rewrites work experience bullet points with strong action verbs. Skill Suggestions Suggests 10 relevant skills based on your job role. Project Summaries Generates concise project descriptions from just a project name. Achievement Writer Crafts impactful, quantified achievement statements. AI Chat Assistant Open-ended chat to brainstorm, draft, or refine any part of your resume. Technology Built with Kotlin & Jetpack Compose UI toolkit Material Design 3 Local storage Room (SQLite) — all data stays on your device AI model Llama 3.1 8B Instant AI provider Groq Cloud API (fast inference) PDF export Android WebView → Print API Privacy Your resume data is stored locally on your device using an encrypted database. It is never uploaded or shared with any server. The only time the app accesses the internet is when you use an AI feature — your text prompt is sent to Groq's API to generate a response and nothing else is transmitted. Contact & Support Have a question, found a bug, or want to suggest a feature? We'd love to hear from you. Go to Settings → Write Us to send us an email.
No account, no cloud ResumeAI works entirely on your device. There is no sign-in, no account, and no server that your resumes are sent to. What's stored, and where Everything you enter — personal details, education, work experience, skills, projects, photos, and your signature — is saved only in this app's private storage on your device, never uploaded anywhere. Nothing leaves your device We don't collect, transmit, sell, or share your resume data with anyone. There is no analytics or tracking of what you type. Permissions we ask for Camera and photo access are used only so you can add a profile photo or signature image, and that image is stored locally like the rest of your resume. Deleting your data Deleting a resume in the app removes it and its photos from your device. Uninstalling the app removes everything, since nothing is kept anywhere else.
Create a resume From the Home or My Resume tab, tap "Create Resume" and enter a name and designation. Fill in your details Open the resume and work through each section — Personal Details, Objective, Education, Work Experience, Skills, and more. Add a photo or signature Use the Profile Photo and Signature sections to capture or pick an image. Choose a template Tap the palette icon to pick from several professional designs — switching templates never loses your entered data. Preview and download Tap the eye icon to see exactly how your resume will look, then tap the print icon to save it as a PDF or print it.
